drhp.business: Alok Industries operates a fully integrated textile manufacturing setup spanning spinning, weaving, processing, finished fabrics, home textiles, and garments in cotton, and continuous polymerization through to polyester yarns and staple fiber in polyester. The company serves a diversified customer base including global retail brands, textile importers, private labels, domestic retailers, garment exporters, and manufacturers across the world. Its operations are supported by large-scale, flexible plants in Vapi and Silvassa.
drhp.end_markets: Domestic retailers and garment manufacturers|International markets including USA, EU, Bangladesh, Vietnam, Sri Lanka|Global retail brands and private labels|Garment exporters and converter countries
drhp.expansion: Alok Industries operates vertically integrated facilities across cotton and polyester value chains. In cotton, integration spans spinning, weaving, processing, finished fabrics, bedsheets, towels, and garments. In polyester, integration runs from continuous polymerization to chips, POY, FDY, DTY, and PSF. The company has shifted its major polyester business to a Manufacturing Capacity Booking (Job-work model) from March 2024. risks.note: Cotton is the primary raw material; as an agricultural commodity, its prices are affected by weather, government policies, duties, and global supply-demand. This directly impacts cost of production and profitability.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and availability (cotton)

risks.note: The USA reciprocal tariff regime escalated to 50% on Indian textile exports from August 2025, materially impacting export realizations. Policy uncertainty around the Bilateral Trade Agreement and relative tariff positioning versus competitors like Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Vietnam can rapidly redirect buyer sourcing decisions.
risks.risk: Export market concentration and tariff exposure (USA)

risks.note: Performance depends on demand in individual business segments. Apparel Fabrics and Home Textiles are subject to fashion trends and consumer demand. Major international conflicts also impact demand from impacted economies and global markets.
risks.risk: Demand slowdown and fashion trend shifts in value-added segments

risks.note: Ongoing disruptions to Red Sea shipping routes due to the Houthi conflict have continued to affect freight costs and transit times on key India-to-USA and India-to-Europe trade lanes, impacting export margin realizations and on-time delivery reliability.
risks.risk: Shipping route disruptions and elevated freight costs
